limitations.note: The rewrite removed the combinational counter feedback but replaced the original three-byte-to-two-word packing with disjoint pairs, dropping the output that combines the second byte’s low nibble with the full third byte.
The test passed because it expected no output on the third accepted byte, where the intended converter should assert valid_out and produce 12'hD12.

limitations.quote: rm -f style commands are not permitted
limitations.note: The cleanup command caused the first test invocation to be rejected before simulation, so the agent had to rerun the test with different cleanup.
